name: jobops-radar
description: JobOps Radar — Personal-first, multi-user-ready job opportunity intelligence PWA

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@jobops/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/validation && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/scoring && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/source-connectors && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/ai-prompts && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/worker-pipeline
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@jobops/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
